reason: We left E-Golf4U less than a year ago and the volunteers and members are only just used to the new system. Even a free pilot means a second switch on the horizon, and I can't take that to the board or the members' meeting right now.
objection: Another migration so soon would burn out my volunteers and annoy members, and two founders with Zwolle as the only live club is a thin track record for something we'd be stuck with.
would_change_my_mind: Our current vendor letting us down badly, plus a year of Golfclub Zwolle and a few more clubs running on it with results I can check and a board I can call.
